environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet, exposed via Network Load Balancer (NLB) on TCP/443 with TLS termination. No additional request inspection layer. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Instance runs the Flask app directly via gunicorn behind nginx reverse proxy. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (Layer 4, TCP passthrough after TLS)
config.reverse_proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass to gunicorn, no ModSecurity
config.database: SQLite 3.40 on local EBS gp3 volume
